study type: Network Meta-analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
cohort: The study cohort consisted of women undergoing cesarean delivery.
finding: Compared with placebo, a single dose of commonly used antibiotics may prevent endometritis and wound infection after cesarean delivery, but did not reduce the incidence of febrile morbidity.
mod_finding: The study found that single doses of commonly used antibiotics can effectively prevent maternal infections (endometritis and wound infection) specifically after cesarean delivery.
